items.title: Fed ajustará progresivamente su calendario de reuniones a partir de 2027, dice Warsh
items.author: Catarina Saraiva
items.summary: El presidente de la Reserva Federal afirmó que el banco central introducirá progresivamente un calendario ajustado de reuniones a partir del próximo año, aunque considera que ocho encuentros anuales s ...
items.body: Bloomberg — El presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, afirmó que el banco central introducirá progresivamente un calendario de reuniones ajustado a partir del próximo año. “Creemos que ocho reuniones al año es el número adecuado para el FOMC”, declaró Warsh el miércoles, después de que los funcionarios de la Reserva Federal votaran por 10 a 2 a favor de mantener las tasas de interés sin cambios, a pesar de las persistentes presiones sobre los precios y los indicios de una economía sólida. Ver más: La Fed mantiene las tasas de interés y espera más datos antes de decidir su próximo movimiento Warsh planteó por primera vez la idea de reducir el número anual de reuniones de política monetaria de la Fed de ocho a seis en la reunión de julio. Según el acta de la reunión, argumentó entonces que reducir la frecuencia de las reuniones permitiría acumular más información y datos entre una y otra. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: 情報ＢＯＸ：ウォーシュ米ＦＲＢ議長の会見要旨
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２８日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２８日　ロイター］ - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は２７─２８日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）でフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を３．７５－４．００％に据え置くと決定した。

ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長がＦＯＭＣ後に行った会見の内容は以下の通り。

＊ＦＯＭＣはより多くの情報が適切な政策スタンスの決定に寄与すると考えている

＊ＦＯＭＣは（経済の）先行きを注視しているが、状況は容易になっていない

＊成長は力強さを増している

＊第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）は３％を上回る公算

＊企業の設備投資は２桁の伸びとなる可能性が高い

＊企業の設備投資は２桁ペースで増加する公算

＊雇用者数の伸びは２０２５年のペースを上回っている

＊雇用情勢は良好

＊われわれの責務はインフレを押し下げること

＊ＦＲＢ内の議論は主に物価安定の責務に焦点が当てられた

＊信用状況はタイト化している

＊市場参加者は資本配分についてより慎重になっている

＊金融状況がタイトだとは言いたくないし、言うこともできない

＊ＦＯＭＣでは活発な議論が交わされた

＊しかしそれらは、より持続的な経済成長と物価安定の方向に向かうものだ

＊地政学や技術についても議論した

＊金融市場のボラティリティーには驚いていない

＊実体経済の活動は正しい方向に向かっている

＊インフレは高すぎる

＊われわれの仕事は、一部セクターでの相対的な価格変動が広範に波及しないようにすること

＊われわれは行動する用意があることを明確にした

＊今後得られる情報が、政策をどこに位置づけたいかの判断に役立つだろう

＊来年の秋にＦＯＭＣの日程を変更することを決定した

＊年８回の会合が適切な回数だ

＊うち１回の会合では政策金利の採決を行わない

＊１回の会合は戦略に焦点を当てたものとなる

＊２０２８年には政策決定会合を年６回とする見通し

＊より長い時間軸を見据えた戦略的な審議のために、時間と余地を確保することが重要

LOS ANGELES, Oct 28 : Kathleen Kennedy, a veteran Hollywood producer and the former president of "Star Wars" film studio Lucasfilm, will lead production of the opening and closing ceremonies for the 2028 Olympics and Paralympics in Los Angeles, organizers said on Wednesday.
Kennedy was named head of ceremonies and content for the Games, replacing Peter Rice, who recently took a job at Netflix. 
She stepped down as president of Lucasfilm in January. Founder George Lucas had chosen her to lead the studio when he sold it to Disney in 2012.
Kennedy co-founded Amblin Entertainment with Steven Spielberg and Frank Marshall, whom she later married, and helped produce classic movies including "E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial," "Jurassic Park" and "Schindler's List."

BRUSSELS, Oct 28 : Meta announced on Wednesday that it was indefinitely delaying the rollout of its new commercial terms following concerns from publishers and digital advertisers, in a move that could stave off potential regulatory action.
EU and UK antitrust authorities have received complaints about the new terms, which publishers and digital advertisers said would give Meta an unlimited right to use their content for its AI services. Meta has rejected the claims.
"We've heard publishers' feedback on our proposed ads and business terms update. We care deeply about our partners and do not plan to make policy changes without a full consultation with industry groups and leaders," Meta said in a statement.
"We're committed to getting this right, and we expect this consultation could extend beyond November 20, in which case we'd delay implementation of the updated terms. Until then our existing terms remain in place," added Meta.

Source: Reuters

Oct 28 : Oracle expects free cash flow to turn positive in the second half of fiscal 2028 and exceed $30 billion in fiscal 2029 as capital spending declines, CFO Hilary Maxson said, offering some relief to investors concerned about its hefty AI outlays.
Shares of the company, down by around a third so far this year, jumped more than 8 per cent in afternoon trading on Wednesday.
Speaking at the cloud and database company's investor day, Maxson said Oracle would begin self-funding its growth in fiscal 2029 and would limit additional capital raises to $20 billion through fiscal 2030.
Oracle has become a focal point of investor worries about the soaring cost of AI infrastructure because it lacks the deep revenue base of cloud giants such as Microsoft and Amazon and relies heavily on a single customer, loss-making ChatGPT maker OpenAI.
For fiscal 2030, the company forecast revenue of more than $225 billion, an adjusted operating margin above 40 per cent and adjusted earnings of more than $21 per share. It reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 forecast of more than $90 billion in revenue and adjusted earnings of $8.10 per share.

Source: Reuters

Oct 28 : Former Barcelona assistant Eder Sarabia has been appointed as Espanyol manager until June 2028, the club said in a statement on Wednesday.
• Sarabia replaces Manolo Gonzalez, who was sacked on Tuesday after a 4-3 Copa del Rey loss to fourth-tier Sestao.
• The 46-year-old was most recently in charge of Elche, guiding them to promotion and then survival in LaLiga in two seasons.
• Sarabia spent seven months as assistant manager to Quique Setien at city rivals Barcelona in 2020.

items.title: Femsa supera previsiones de ventas gracias al impulso de Oxxo en México
items.author: Valentine Hilaire, Amy Stillman
items.summary: El aumento del tráfico y del gasto en las tiendas de conveniencia sugiere que los consumidores están empezando a dejar atrás parte de la cautela de trimestres previos.
items.body: Bloomberg — Fomento Económico Mexicano SAB ( FEMSAUBD ) superó las expectativas de ventas en el último trimestre, ya que sus tiendas de conveniencia Oxxo atrajeron a consumidores que gastaron más, una señal de que la compañía se está beneficiando de señales de recuperación de la economía mexicana. Los ingresos del tercer trimestre aumentaron a MXN$235.610 millones, según un comunicado publicado el miércoles, por encima del promedio de MXN$231.120 millones de las estimaciones de analistas recopiladas por Bloomberg. La utilidad neta creció un 81%, a MXN$10.570 millones, en el periodo. Ver más: Emisión simplificada en Bolsa Mexicana despertó interés para más listados en deuda y acciones: CEO El aumento del tráfico y del gasto en Oxxo sugiere que los consumidores mexicanos están empezando a dejar atrás parte de la cautela que recientemente ha llevado a la empresa a registrar resultados moderados. Sin embargo, la fortaleza del peso afectó las ganancias de Femsa en el extranjero, en particular las de su negocio europeo de tiendas de conveniencia Valora. “Estamos particularmente entusiasmados con la continua recuperación de Oxxo México”, dijo el director ejecutivo, José Antonio Fernández Garza-Lagüera, en el comunicado. “Al entrar en el último trimestre del año, seguimos conscientes de que el entorno del consumidor en México continúa débil, Brasil ha enfrentado cierta volatilidad recientemente y tendremos una base de comparación más exigente en los próximos trimestres”. Los ingresos totales de Oxxo México aumentaron un 10% frente al mismo trimestre del año anterior y la utilidad operativa creció un 5,8%. Lee más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: US goods trade deficit widens in September as AI boom drives imports to record high
items.author: Sneha Biswas
items.summary: According to Reuters, US goods trade deficit widened from $2.8 billion to $134.9 billion in September. While imports of goods increase $8.1 billion to $344.1 billion, goods exports climbed from $5.3 billion to $209.2 billion.
items.body:
The US trade deficit in goods widened more than expected in September. This comes as imports climbed to a record high. According to Reuters, the surge is driven by demand for capital goods associated with the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure boom, indicating that trade could have weighed heavily on economic growth in the third quarter.
The latest deterioration in the trade balance is reported by the Commerce Department on Wednesday, as per the news agency. Reportedly, it prompted some economists to estimate that trade may have shaved as much as four percentage points off Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth in the July-September quarter.
However, the government's advance estimate of third-quarter GDP, scheduled for release on Thursday, is still expected to show strong growth, supported by a surge in AI-related investments and resilient consumer spending.
"Although trade will weigh on quarterly GDP, this is a sign of strength rather than weakness for the US economy as it signifies continued business investment and momentum for consumer spending," said Daniel Vielhaber, an economist at Nationwide, as quoted by Reuters.
US goods trade
The goods trade deficit rose 2.1%, or $2.8 billion, to $134.9 billion in September. It marked the highest level since March 2025, the Commerce Department's Census Bureau said. Economists surveyed by Reuters had predicted the deficit to come in at $130.2 billion.
The goods trade gap continued to widen through the third quarter.
Imports of goods increased 2.4%, or $8.1 billion, to a record $344.1 billion in September, led by a 7.5% increase in capital goods. Capital goods imports surged 77.2% from a year earlier.
"So much of the hardware that the tech companies need is coming from overseas, driving a massive widening in the trade gap," said Stephen Stanley, chief US economist at Santander US Capital Markets to Reuters.
Imports vs exports
Besides the AI investment boom, sustained consumer spending despite rising living costs has also been cited as contributing to the increase in imports.
Consumer goods imports rose 3.1% in September, while imports of other goods increased 6.7%. Imports of industrial supplies, which include gold and petroleum, declined 6.0%.
For the unversed, gold is excluded from the calculation of GDP.
Imports of food and motor vehicles also fell during the month.
In terms of export, shipments of goods increased $5.3 billion, or 2.6%, to $209.2 billion in September.
Food exports jumped 12.8%, while exports of capital goods rose 5.4% and consumer products advanced 6.5%. Exports of motor vehicles and industrial supplies also saw a decline, Reuters reported.
Trade weighs on GDP growth
Economists estimated that trade could subtract four percentage points from GDP growth in the third quarter, while those at Oxford Economics put the drag at 3.25 percentage points.
Trade has not contributed to US GDP growth for three consecutive quarters, added the report.
However, it is believed that a portion of September's imports ended up as unsold inventory at wholesalers and retailers, which could potentially help cushion the impact on GDP.
The Census Bureau reported that wholesale inventories increased 0.6% in September. Reportedly, retail inventories rose 0.3%. Stocks at motor vehicle and parts dealers increased 0.2%.
Apart from motor vehicles and parts, retail inventories rose 0.4% in September after edging up 0.1% in August.
Previously, a Reuters survey of economists had forecast the US economy to grow at an annualised rate of 3.2% in the third quarter, compared with 2.2% in the second quarter.

items.title: 米ＦＲＢ、10対2で金利据え置き　景気判断引き上げ追加利上げに含み
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン　２８日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Howard Schneider

[ワシントン　２８日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は２７─２８日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）でフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を３．７５－４．００％に据え置くと決定した。決定は１０対２。１１月３日に中間選挙を控える中、インフレ動向に関するさらなるデータを見極める姿勢を示した。

ＦＲＢは声明で、インフレはなお高水準にあると指摘するとともに、景気判断を引き上げ、今後のインフレ動向次第では追加利上げを実施する可能性を示唆した。

ＦＲＢは前回９月のＦＯＭＣで３年２か月ぶりの利上げを決定。今回はクック理事とクリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁が２会合連続となる０．２５％ポイントの利上げを主張し、金利据え置きに反対票を投じた。

今回の声明には、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が避けたい意向を示していた「フォワードガイダンス」を示唆する内容が盛り込まれ、９月の声明から変化が見られた。声明は、より多くの情報が蓄積されれば、インフレ率を目標とする２％に速やかに戻すために適切な政策スタンスを判断する助けとなるとした上で、「委員会は物価安定を実現する」と表明。経済活動については「力強い（strong）ペースで拡大している」とし、前回の「堅調な（solid）ペースで拡大している」から判断を引き上げた。

また、設備投資は「堅調（robust）」とし、雇用の伸びは労働人口の増加に追い付いており、失業率はあまり変化していないとした。

金利据え置きは広く予想されていたため、金融市場の反応は限定的だった。ただ、アンパサンドのケリー・ブラウン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「金利据え置きは安心材料ではない」と指摘。「ＦＲＢは実体経済に対し、もうしばらく様子を見るよう求めている。インフレ率が３．７％となお高水準にあり、原油価格が１バレル＝１００ドルを超える中、企業は借入コストが近く低下すると当てにすることはできない」と述べた。

items.title: U.S. Federal Reserve keeps rates unchanged despite elevated inflation, gives little signal of its next move
items.author: The Associated Press
items.summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve kept its key rate unchanged Wednesday at about 3.9% despite elevated inflation, while providing little hint about the central bank’s next moves.
items.body: WASHINGTON — The U.S. Federal Reserve kept its key rate unchanged Wednesday at about 3.9% despite elevated inflation, while providing little hint about the central bank’s next moves. “Inflation remains elevated,” the Fed said in a statement released after its two-day policy meeting. Holding off on an increase will allow “the accumulation of more information” that will help determine what policy the Fed should pursue “to ensure a timely return of inflation” to the central bank’s two per cent inflation target, the statement said. The Fed, led by Chairman Kevin Warsh, raised its benchmark rate last month for the first time in three years, defying U.S. President Donald Trump’s demands for rate cuts, in an effort to get inflation back to its two per cent target in a “timelier” manner. The Fed is tasked by Congress to combat inflation, and it does so by lifting rates to slow borrowing and spending and cool price increases. Two Fed officials dissented from Wednesday’s decision, with Fed governor Lisa Cook and Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack voting in favor of hiking rates by a quarter point. Cook has been targeted by the Trump administration, which tried to fire her last year, though the Supreme Court in June ruled she could keep her job while litigation played out. No president has fired a Fed governor before, a sign of the Fed’s longstanding independence from day-to-day politics. Trump renewed his attempt to remove Cook last month by setting up a committee to look into allegations Cook committed mortgage fraud, which she has denied. Christopher Rugaber, The Associated Press

FAST

Oct 28 : Santos captain Neymar has been handed a two-match suspension for covering his mouth while arguing with an opponent during Saturday's 1-1 Brazilian Serie A draw with Bahia, Brazil's Superior Court of Sports Justice (STJD) said on Wednesday.
The 34-year-old was sent off following an altercation with Bahia midfielder Rodrigo Nestor, and the sports tribunal found him guilty of violating the Vinicius Jr. rule that forbids players from covering their mouths during on-field confrontations.
The STJD said the referee's report also noted that Neymar, after being sent off, ran towards the visitors' bench to confront his opponent and had to be restrained by teammates.
The suspension means Neymar will miss Santos' next three matches. He is already banned for Wednesday's league game against Palmeiras after accumulating three yellow cards and will serve two additional matches for the protocol violation.

The latest suspension comes three months after Neymar became the first player in Brazil's top flight to be temporarily removed from the field under a new rule being tested in the league to curb time-wasting by goalkeepers.
The former Brazil captain is not expected to return to action until late November.

items.title: Datanomics: Jio breaks decade-long trend of record IPOs listing at discount
items.author: Shreya Eswaran
items.summary: Platforms' 21% listing gain bucks a trend of weak debuts by India's biggest IPOs as the issue sets a new fundraising record ...
items.body: Shares of Jio Platforms listed on the NSE at ₹1,358 apiece compared to the issue price of ₹1,119, a gain of over 21 per cent for investors. Jio’s performance was an exception to a decade-long trend of record-sized initial public offerings (IPOs) listing at a loss for investors. A record-sized IPO is one that is the biggest in terms of value compared to previous ones. This underper­formance got amplified with the launch of One 97 Communications’ record IPO in November 2021, the first record IPO in the period under consideration. The issue sizes of three successive record-setting IPOs increased by 10 per cent, 35 per cent, and 8 per cent over their respective previous records, while listing performance remained under pressure till Jio broke the trend.

Oct 28 : Alphabet's Google on Wednesday unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model, stepping up competition with OpenAI and Anthropic as the race to build more capable coding and cybersecurity systems intensifies.
The launch comes two weeks after Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon, as the company expands its Gemini family of AI models for developers and enterprise customers.
Here are some details:
• The company said the Carbon model delivers state-of-the-art performance across cybersecurity tasks including vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and software patching

• Google said Carbon generates secure code at more than twice the success rate of Gemini 4 Argon on internal benchmarks
• The model is designed to handle complex, long-running engineering and coding tasks
• Carbon is being made available first to a subset of cybersecurity defenders through Google's Fairwind Program as the company continues testing safeguards
• Gemini 4 Carbon will be priced at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, matching Gemini 4 Argon's introductory pricing

items.title: Las mejores ciudades para celebrar Halloween en 2026
items.summary: Ya sea para salir a pedir dulces, encontrar las mejores tiendas de disfraces, un estudio revela los mejores destinos para celebrar la noche de brujas en Estados Unidos.
items.body: Halloween es una de las mayores fiestas en Estados Unidos. Entre calabazas, recorridos para pedir dulces, disfraces y decoraciones gigantescas, la celebración se ha convertido en un referente cultural que conquista a chicos y grandes cada 31 de octubre. ¿Pero, cuáles son los mejores lugares para celebrar Halloween en 2026? Un estudio de WalletHub identificó los destinos sobresalientes para disfrutar la festividad y Nueva York se impuso en el primer lugar. Para elaborar el ranking, la plataforma comparó las 100 ciudades más grandes de EE.UU. a partir de 20 indicadores clave, como la seguridad, el número de tiendas de disfraces per cápita y hasta la amabilidad hacia quienes piden dulces. A partir de ello, asignó una calificación a cada localidad. Nueva York lideró y su 71,22 de calificación la convirtieron en “el mejor lugar parta celebrar la fecha”. Destacó por tener el segundo mayor número de tiendas de disfraces, la mayor cantidad de dulcerías por habitantes y su facilidad para desplazarse caminando. “Además, sus residentes realizan más búsquedas en Google sobre ‘fiestas de Halloween’ y términos relacionados que los habitantes de cualquier otra ciudad”, señaló WalletHub. Los Ángeles ocupó el segundo puesto por su diversidad de opciones como campos de calabazas, tiendas de artículos para fiestas y casas embrujadas. Detrás de esa capital, está Jersey City (60,58 de calificación), que destaca por su facilidad para desplazarse a pie, “lo que la convierte en un entorno ideal para salir a pedir dulces durante Halloween”. La cuarta posición la ocupó Las Vegas, que obtuvo 58,76 de calificación, mientras que el quinto puesto se asignó a Chicago, con 58,46 de calificación. No es de extrañar que las ciudades estadounidenses se disputen las posiciones en el ranking, pues Halloween de paso quita un poco de terror a la economía. De acuerdo con la National Retail Federation, 74% de los habitantes planea celebrar Halloween y gastará en promedio US$115 por persona. En total, el gasto de los consumidores para la festividad se proyecta en US$13.500 millones. Para dimensionar la cifra, solo US$4.400 millones se destinarán a disfraces, US$4.300 millones en decoraciones; US$4.100 millones en dulces y US$800 millones en tarjetas de felicitación.

items.title: Wealthsimple raises $425M in latest equity round, putting its valuation at $13.8B
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: Wealthsimple Inc. says it has raised $425 million in financing from its existing investors, which it says will help it expand its services.
items.body: TORONTO — Wealthsimple Inc. says it has raised $425 million in financing from its existing investors, which it says will help it expand its services and challenge incumbent lenders. The company announced in a news release Tuesday that the equity round, which includes a $300 million primary offering and a $125 million secondary offering, will put its valuation at $13.8 billion. The company says the secondary offering will give employees an opportunity to “share in the value they’ve helped create.” GIC, the Singapore sovereign wealth fund, led the round of financing along with participation from Power Corp. of Canada, IGM Financial Inc., the Canada Pension Plan Investment Board and others. Michael Katchen, Wealthsimple’s CEO and co-founder, says the group of investors know the business well, and the support will help it continue to innovate. Wealthsimple says it plans to use the money to help grow its business, including personal banking as well as trading and investment products. --- Daniel Johnson, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 28, 2026.

items.title: ＥＵ・カナダ共同声明、「準加盟国」構想盛り込まず＝草案
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Maria Cheng　Andrew Gray

[オタワ／ブリュッセル　２８日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Maria Cheng　Andrew Gray

[オタワ／ブリュッセル　２８日　ロイター] - カナダを欧州連合（ＥＵ）初の「準加盟国」として受け入れる構想について、３０日から開かれるＥＵ・カナダ首脳会合の共同声明に盛り込まれないことが２８日、ロイターが入手した草案で分かった。

ＥＵ・カナダ首脳会合はカナダのカーニー首相の主催でモントリオールで開幕。関係を一段と緊密化することで合意すると見られているが、声明草案によると、カナダとＥＵの関係を定義する作業は来年のＥＵ・カナダ首脳会合まで継続される。

これまでの共同声明案には、カナダを「準加盟国」と位置付ける表現が少なくとも２カ所盛り込まれており、この用語の定義づけにはさらに１年を要するとの認識も示されていた。ＥＵの「準加盟国」には前例も法的定義も存在しない。

カナダをＥＵの「準加盟国」とする構想については、ＥＵの執行機関である欧州委員会のフォンデアライエン委員長が９月１６日に行った欧州議会での一般教書演説で表明。カーニー首相はその翌日に行った欧州議会での演説で、同構想を歓迎し、米国と中国が支配する世界で市場、民主主義、法の支配を守るため、カナダと欧州が連携を強化すべきだと訴えていた。

ただ、ドイツを中心とする一部加盟国が「準加盟国」という法的地位がなく、内容も具体化されていない構想を受け入れることはできないと主張するなど、ＥＵ・カナダ首脳会合の共同声明を巡りＥＵ加盟国の間で見解の相違が出ていた。

トランプ米大統領がカナダ製品に関税を課す中、カーニー首相は欧州との関係強化を戦略の重要な柱の１つとしている。ただ、カナダのＥＵへの接近はトランプ大統領の反発を招く可能性もある。実際、トランプ大統領はカナダをＥＵの「準加盟国」とする提案を「ばかげている」と非難し、こうした動きを自身が「敵対行為」と見なした場合は、欧州との貿易を多くの分野で停止する可能性があると警告している。

items.title: ‘We think it’s premature’: Expert reaction to the Bank of Canada’s first rate hike since 2023
items.author: Jordan Fleguel
items.summary: The Bank of Canada raised its key interest rate for the first time in more than three years on Wednesday, drawing mixed reaction from experts and lawmakers.
items.body: The Bank of Canada raised its key interest rate for the first time in more than three years on Wednesday, drawing mixed reaction from experts and lawmakers. The central bank’s governor, Tiff Macklem, said in remarks Wednesday that elevated global energy prices could soon seep into other parts of the Canadian economy, and the hike was needed to reduce that risk. Earl Davis, head of fixed income and money markets at BMO Global Asset Management, told BNN Bloomberg following the bank’s decision that Macklem’s comments suggest the bank is “trying to get ahead of the game.” But a rate hike on its own won’t prevent the knock-on effects of higher oil prices, Davis said. “That will happen no matter what, but it prevents people from buying ahead of time and controlling inflation,” he said. “So (Macklem) is trying to get ahead of it, and that seems to be explicitly stated in the statement.” The bank’s decision to hike comes as Canada’s economy continues to grapple with uncertainty due to shifting geopolitical dynamics and a trading relationship with the U.S. that has fundamentally changed. Canadian workers have paid the price for the country’s economic sluggishness. Statistics Canada said earlier this month that the economy shed a net 68,300 jobs in September, effectively erasing the employment gains made earlier this year. ‘Pre-emptive hike’ Davis said that according to the Bank of Canada’s October Monetary Policy Report, released Wednesday, the bank has put a renewed emphasis on mitigating the impacts of a “persistent supply shock” in energy markets. “In layman’s terms, the persistence of how high oil has been, and the price of oil at this level for so long… will impact inflation expectations of consumers for the next six months to a year, which means they will buy more and consume more now to get ahead of inflation,” he said. “So, we see this hike as a pre-emptive hike.” Davis said the decision didn’t come as a surprise to him, as the 25-basis-point increase was widely expected, but he added that the move was likely made too early. “Why we think it’s premature is… last week we had a lot of equity volatility, a lot of risk of market nervousness, which has calmed down this week, but we expect that volatility to return and remain there for the fourth quarter, which adds to uncertainty,” he explained. RSM Canada economist Tu Nguyen said in an emailed statement to BNN Bloomberg that the bank’s “decidedly hawkish” tone sends a clear message. “This is the first hike in a hiking cycle. Expect the next rate hike as early as December – with more to follow in 2027,” she said. “The Bank of Canada won’t be alone in raising rates. Rather, it’s set to be one of several major central banks embarking on a hiking cycle… ahead of tightening global financial conditions in 2027 that could thwart growth.” ‘Silver lining’ Wednesday’s rate hike also comes at a time when many Canadians are struggling with the overall cost of living, and higher interest rates will be an additional challenge, said Ontario Premier Doug Ford in a post to X on Wednesday. “Higher rates won’t get oil moving through the Strait of Hormuz or lower tariffs on Canadian businesses,” he wrote. “They will only make life more expensive for Canadian families and workers, punishing them for something they can’t control.” Davis said that while the Bank of Canada may have moved into a hiking cycle too early, the decision may ultimately have “a silver lining.” “It may very well be the right thing in hindsight, but because it’s premature, the market was, prior to this, discounting an additional 100-basis-points-plus of hikes, including today’s,” he said. “We think that will be reduced now to possibly 75, or the market thinking the Bank of Canada will hike less over the coming year because today was a bit premature.” With files from CP24’s Phil Tsekouras and The Canadian Press

Possible new dwarf planet identified orbiting beyond Pluto

This image shows the orbital pathway of the newly discovered dwarf planet candidate 2026 ED138, as observed by the US National Science Foundation/Department of Energy Vera C. Rubin Observatory. This image is a composite of multiple images captured by Rubin between March 4 and July 11, 2026, at intervals indicated by the teal-colored circles. ED138 is visible at the center of each circle. WASHINGTON, Oct 28 : Scientists using a Chile-based telescope have identified an icy object orbiting beyond Pluto that may join our solar system's small roster of dwarf planets.
Researchers said the candidate, named 2026 ED138, has a diameter estimated at between roughly 370 and 930 miles (600 and 1,500 km) and is orbiting about 46 times farther from the sun than Earth. By way of comparison, Pluto orbits at an average of about 40 times farther from the sun than Earth.
The object was spotted using the new Vera C. Rubin Observatory, on the summit of the Cerro Pachón mountain in central Chile. The telescope is a joint initiative of the US National Science Foundation and US Department of Energy.
Further observations are needed to confirm that the object is a dwarf planet.

If confirmed, 2026 ED138 would join five other dwarf planets recognized by the International Astronomical Union, the global authority on classifying celestial bodies. Those are Pluto, Eris, Haumea and Makemake, all of which orbit beyond the outermost planet Neptune, and Ceres, located in the main asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.
Based on the current data, 2026 ED138 would be among the largest of the dwarf planets.
"For me, what this demonstrates is that many exciting discoveries remain to be made with the Rubin Observatory and other telescopes," said astrophysicist Matt Holman of the Center for Astrophysics, Harvard & Smithsonian, who first spotted 2026 ED138.
Pluto long was considered the solar system's ninth and outermost planet, but was reclassified by the International Astronomical Union as a dwarf planet in 2006 because it did not meet the organization's formal definition of a planet. Pluto and the new dwarf planet candidate reside in a frigid region of the solar system populated by various icy bodies.
There are still questions about the size and composition of 2026 ED138. To be considered a dwarf planet, an object must possess sufficient mass for its own gravity to pull it into a round shape. 2026 ED138 appears to have sufficient mass for that, but more observations are needed.
"The main thing we need to do is to establish the physical size of 2026 ED138," Holman said.
"When we observe with Rubin, we are seeing the sun's light reflected from the object," Holman said. "A smaller, more reflective object would show the same amount of light as a larger, less reflective object. Fortunately, by looking at longer wavelengths, with an observatory like ALMA, we can detect the light emitted by the object itself," which is helpful in measuring an object's size.
ALMA, or the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array, is a powerful telescope also based in Chile.
The discovery was announced at a scientific meeting in Spokane, Washington.

Source: Reuters

By Stephen Nellis
SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 28 : German startup NVision on Wednesday published a paper in the scientific journal Nature showing a new way to make quantum computing chips that would borrow from the widespread manufacturing techniques currently used in smartphone displays.
Startups and tech giants such as Microsoft and IBM alike are racing to build quantum computers that hold the promise of solving problems that would take conventional machines thousands of years. But NVision, which has raised $120 million in funding from public and private sources such as Abbott Laboratories, made the discovery published on Wednesday while working in an entirely different field: improving medical devices.

The company had developed a machine that can zap special sugar molecules until the spin of their electrons aligned. The aligned spins make the sugars a thousand times easier for MRI machines to see, which in turn helps identify cancer cells that eat the sugars far faster than healthy cells.
In the research published Wednesday, NVision showed that its technology can also work on organic molecules similar to those used in organic light-emitting diode (OLED) displays widely used in the electronics business. NVision used AI to simulate hundreds of candidate molecules and then physically synthesized about 40 of them until it found one that could be laid down in a thin layer over a chip made with conventional technology to create a quantum chip. 
"We found this 'Goldilocks' molecule," Ilai Schwartz, NVision's chief technology officer, told Reuters in an interview.
NVision also said on Wednesday that it is partnering with US-based chipmaker HyperLight to make its first chips. NVision CEO Sella Brosh said that the company plans to build an entire quantum computer rather than sell only its specialized molecules.
"We want to do the whole thing, to fabricate the chips, to deposit the molecules, to do all the error correction on top of it," Brosh said in an interview. "Eventually, what we will sell is a rack-ready computer."

Source: Reuters

WASHINGTON, Oct 28 : Anthropic told California Governor Gavin Newsom that government officials should be able to seek court orders blocking the release of AI models that pose a "serious risk" to the public, according to an October 15 letter that echoed the company's earlier policy proposals.
Anthropic itself has faced government restrictions on its AI systems. The Trump administration in June ordered Anthropic to immediately restrict foreign access to its cyber-capable Mythos 5 and Fable 5 models, citing national security concerns. The US Commerce Department later lifted the order. 
"When a review finds a model poses a serious risk, the government should be able to ask a court to block it," the letter to Newsom said. 
An Anthropic spokesperson confirmed the letter is authentic. The California governor's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Anthropic submitted the recommendations after the governor in September convened a panel of artificial intelligence experts to develop proposals for AI safety requirements.
The company also said it opposes requirements that developers build "kill switches" capable of shutting down entire AI models in the event a company loses control over their actions. Instead, Anthropic supports more targeted interventions, such as disabling a problematic AI agent or cutting off a specific customer's access to a model, according to the letter, saying they would be more effective.
A bipartisan group of US senators in September were debating legislation that would give the US government the power to block the release of certain AI models that are deemed unsafe, Reuters reported, and companies would be able to challenge that decision in federal court. Congress left for its pre-election break shortly after, and lawmakers have not moved forward on that proposal. 
US House lawmakers in July proposed the "AI Kill Switch Act," which would give US officials the power to order AI firms to shut down models that put human life or the economy at risk. 
Anthropic is preparing for a US initial public offering. The listing would represent one of the most consequential stock market debuts in years, potentially reshaping benchmark indexes, investor flows and the broader narrative driving US equities.
Politico first reported the details of the letter. 

Source: Reuters

WASHINGTON, Oct 28 : Anthropic told California Governor Gavin Newsom that government officials should be able to seek court orders blocking the release of AI models that pose a "serious risk" to the public, according to an October 15 letter that echoed the company's earlier policy proposals.
Anthropic itself has faced government restrictions on its AI systems. The Trump administration in June ordered Anthropic to immediately restrict foreign access to its cyber-capable Mythos 5 and Fable 5 models, citing national security concerns. The US Commerce Department later lifted the order. 
"When a review finds a model poses a serious risk, the government should be able to ask a court to block it," the letter to Newsom said. 
An Anthropic spokesperson confirmed the letter is authentic. The California governor's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Anthropic submitted the recommendations after the governor in September convened a panel of artificial intelligence experts to develop proposals for AI safety requirements.
The company also said it opposes requirements that developers build "kill switches" capable of shutting down entire AI models in the event a company loses control over their actions. Instead, Anthropic supports more targeted interventions, such as disabling a problematic AI agent or cutting off a specific customer's access to a model, according to the letter, saying they would be more effective.
A bipartisan group of US senators in September were debating legislation that would give the US government the power to block the release of certain AI models that are deemed unsafe, Reuters reported, and companies would be able to challenge that decision in federal court. Congress left for its pre-election break shortly after, and lawmakers have not moved forward on that proposal. 
US House lawmakers in July proposed the "AI Kill Switch Act," which would give US officials the power to order AI firms to shut down models that put human life or the economy at risk. 
Anthropic is preparing for a US initial public offering. The listing would represent one of the most consequential stock market debuts in years, potentially reshaping benchmark indexes, investor flows and the broader narrative driving US equities.
Politico first reported the details of the letter. 

Source: Reuters

Oct 28 : Italy coach Gonzalo Quesada says an increasingly relentless rugby calendar is exacting its toll on players as his injury-hit squad prepare for November's Nations Championship fixtures.
Quesada's Italy lost all three matches in July, against Japan, New Zealand and Australia, and while next month brings home advantage, they take on South Africa, Argentina and Fiji without several key players.
When Quesada announced his squad last week, 13 players were unavailable, including centre Tommaso Menoncello and flanker Sebastian Negri.
Captain Michele Lamaro, centre Juan Ignacio Brex and winger Louis Lynagh are the latest injury absentees.

"We play for almost 10-and-a-half months a year, never respecting a proper regeneration cycle, real recovery," Quesada told reporters on Wednesday.
"What happens is simple: players play, play, play until the body says enough. In the end, the body forces you to respect recovery.
"It has always been like this, but the game is now played at a higher level when players have better physical capacity. The fitter we are, the more collisions there are, the more the ball is in play, the greater the actual playing time."
Italy's most experienced player, flyhalf Tommaso Allan, is in the squad, but is recovering from injury and has yet to take part in training.
"He is one of the players we are assessing as a potential member of the matchday squad," Quesada said.
"In a normal situation, a player who is only returning to training in the same week as a match would generally never be selected.
"But in the current circumstances, the lack of options may force us into that position."

Source: Reuters

LONDON, Oct 28 : British retiree David Bright has no stud farm or royal title, but a small stake he bought in a syndicate-owned mare named Tiffany has earned him a trip to Kentucky for this week's $5 million Breeders' Cup Turf.
Horse racing's biggest prizes are often the preserve of sheikhs, royalty and titans of industry, but Bright found another way into the sport of kings through a syndicate that sold 1,000 shares in Tiffany for about £500 ($664) each.
Bright, who used to work with hot air balloons, will visit breeding farms and bourbon distilleries before arriving at Keeneland to watch Tiffany line up against some of the world's best turf horses for the last time on Saturday.
"I get hyper anxious and I won’t sleep the night before," Bright told Reuters. "I'll be fidgeting like no one's business waiting for it to happen, I can’t look at the horses racing, I can’t watch it at all."

Bright has seen Tiffany run five times, including when she won her first Group 1, the Grosser Preis von Berlin at Hoppegarten in Germany. 
MOTHERHOOD ON THE CARDS 
The 1-1/2 mile Breeders' Cup Turf is particularly poignant for Bright because it will be Tiffany's last race. She is due to be sold as a broodmare at the end of November at Tattersalls where the hope is she will fetch more than £1 million.
Elite Racing Club's former stable star Marsha, who finished sixth in the Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint in 2017, made over £6 million ($8 million) when she was sold, a European record. 
"It's got to be a once-in-a-lifetime because I don't know whether we would have another horse capable of going to a Breeders' Cup," Bright said. 
Trainer Mark Prescott said the mare had "little to lose and a lot to gain," in Keeneland and that winning the race would be another dream come true for him. The mare's successes in Germany and the United States should add to her appeal for buyers, he added.  
In Kentucky she will take on top horses from powerhouses like Ballydoyle, which sends market leaders Diamond Necklace and Benvenuto Cellini, El Cordobes, who carries the colours of Dubai's ruling family the Al Maktoums, and last year's winner Ethical Diamond from Willie Mullins' yard in Ireland.
Diamond Necklace is the race favourite at 3–1 morning-line odds. Tiffany is tied with Ethical Diamond for fifth-best odds at 10–1.
BRINGING RACING TO THE MASSES
Bright, who is allergic to horses, will have the full owner's experience at Keeneland including parade ring passes and entry to one of the race meeting's lavish functions alongside private equity supremos and Bahraini royals.
He is one of 42 Tiffany owners making the trip from Britain, Germany and Venezuela and should she win the race, Bright will be entitled to a share of the $2.6 million winner's cheque. 
This is thanks to Elite Racing, a club set up in 1992, which brings the sometimes exclusive sport to the masses for a fraction of the cost. Elite's syndicate allows the enjoyment of owning a horse without having to pay for training fees or vets' bills.  
Micro-ownership is also increasingly important for an industry in Britain grappling with higher costs, lower prize money and structural issues like declining foal crops, talent drain abroad and regulatory pressure on the gambling industry. 
It is a strategy adopted around the world and Japan is sending the syndicate-owned Deep Monster to this year's Breeders' Cup Turf.
"I don’t think the industry would survive without that involvement of syndicates and clubs," said Dan Downie, Elite Racing's racing manager.
"If we were relying on single ownerships or small partnerships there wouldn’t be much racing and eventually it would disappear." 
($1 = 0.7527 pounds)

Source: Reuters

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Greg Bensinger

[サンフランシスコ ２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Greg Bensinger

[サンフランシスコ ２８日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムが、端末・サービス部門で約２５０人を削減したことが分かった。同社はロイターに対し、人員削減を認めた。広報担当者は「少数の職務を廃止するという難しい決断を下した」と述べたが、詳細は明らかにしなかった。

事情に詳しい関係者によると、削減対象は最大２５０人で、主にソフトウエア開発に携わる従業員だった。

広報担当者は、人員削減によって「業務の効率を高め、製品開発計画との整合性を向上させる」と説明した。

同社はここ数週間、電子書籍端末「キンドル」やタブレット端末の新製品などを相次いで投入。２８日には、音声アシスタント「アレクサ」を搭載した新たな目覚まし時計とフォトフレームも発表した。

アマゾンは今月に入り、中核の小売部門でも約１０００人を削減している。

items.body:
[キーウ　２８日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２８日、ウクライナ、ロシア、米国の和平交渉担当者による３カ国協議が、１１月６日─１０日にアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビで開催されることを望んでいると述べた。 

ゼレンスキー氏は、戦争終結の方法を巡る協議に欧州が関与することを望んでいると述べ、結束とロシアに対するより強い圧力が必要だと訴えた。

一方、ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官（外交担当）は、ウクライナ紛争の解決を巡る次回の３カ国協議に欧州の代表は参加しないと述べた。インタファクス通信が伝えた。

ウシャコフ氏は、プーチン大統領が２７日にフィンランドのストゥブ大統領、ノルウェーのストーレ首相と行った電話会談では、欧州諸国の交渉への参加の可能性は議論されなかったと言及。

来月アブダビで開催される見通しの協議の日程については、まだ合意されていないと述べた。

Oct 28 : Sergio Perez has signed a multi-year contract extension with Cadillac that will keep the Mexican driver with the American Formula One team until 2029, the team said on Wednesday.
Perez celebrates a milestone 300th Grand Prix start at the 36-year-old's home race in Mexico City this weekend. A six-times Grand Prix winner, Perez moved to Cadillac for their debut season on the grid.
"Joining Cadillac from day one was a project I truly believed in, and extending my commitment feels like a natural continuation of this chapter," Perez said in a statement.
"Building a Formula One team from the ground up takes time, relentless work and patience, but the progress we are making together is incredibly rewarding. There is still a lot of work ahead of us and I am fully committed for the next three years."
A veteran who has raced in Formula One since 2011, Perez finished third in the 2022 drivers' championship and second the following season behind team mate Max Verstappen when he was with Red Bull Racing.

Source: Reuters

Oct 28 : Prediction markets are seeing massive trades for Anthropic contracts after the AI giant's IPO filing, even as retail stock traders await the official opening bell likely next month.
The binary "yes" or "no" bets in prediction markets are influencing the way retail investors speculate on high-profile IPOs, allowing traders to wager on aspects such as the closing prices and its listing venue without the need to buy shares.
"Prediction market interest in Anthropic's IPO is the financial equivalent of people lining up outside the Apple Store before a new iPhone release," said Michael Ashley Schulman, a partner at wealth management and financial advisory firm Cerity Partners.
Earlier this week, Anthropic took a major step toward going public by unveiling its IPO filing. The listing could value the AI lab behind the Claude models at between $1.5 trillion and $2 trillion, Reuters has reported.

On Polymarket, more than a dozen markets have sprung up around the IPO, where traders are placing bets on its fundraising haul, listing exchange and debut valuation.
Rival Kalshi is also drawing bets on everything from which bank will lead the offering to which sector index providers will classify Anthropic in. Combined, the markets have attracted tens of millions of dollars in volume.
"It is a healthy sign of robust interest and the wagers placed may help the market zero in on its eventual public market opening price," said Schulman.
Prediction markets allow users to buy and sell contracts tied to the outcome of real-life events, with prices fluctuating as traders weigh the odds of the different outcomes.
Once largely tied to politics and economic data, the platforms are increasingly moving into traditional Wall Street turf, offering tens of thousands of markets on stock moves, company data and other corporate events that often drive shares, Reuters reported last month.
IPO investing, however, has long been dominated by deep-pocketed institutional investors. Although retail participation has expanded in recent years, including around Elon Musk's SpaceX listing, issuers still allocate only a small portion of offerings to individual investors.
"The Anthropic IPO is going to be a crucial litmus test about both individual and institutional investors' appetite for AI," said Steve Sosnick, chief strategist at Interactive Brokers.
The Polymarket contract on the timing of Anthropic's IPO had drawn $6 million in trading volume as of 9:30 a.m. ET (1330 GMT) on October 28. A separate market on the AI company's closing market capitalization had attracted about $3 million.
"Prediction markets are clearly becoming an integral part of many investors' approach to financial risk management and speculation," Sosnick said.

Source: Reuters

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 28 : Amazon cut about 250 jobs on Wednesday in its devices and services unit after weeks of product rollouts including new Kindle e-readers and tablet computers.
The company confirmed the cuts after a Reuters inquiry. "We've made the difficult decision to eliminate a small number of roles," a spokesperson said without elaborating.
The cuts affected no more than 250 jobs, said a person familiar with the matter, primarily in software development. 
The layoffs will help the company "operate more efficiently and better align with our product roadmap," the spokesperson said. Amazon on Wednesday also announced a new Alexa-powered alarm clock and photo frame.
As is the company's custom, text messages and emails were sent to workers early Wednesday morning. One seen by Reuters was from Cherie Robinson, a human resources vice president in devices and services, saying the company had undergone "a thorough review of our structure" resulting in the need for cuts.
Earlier this month, Amazon pared about 1,000 jobs in its core retail division. The company reports its third-quarter earnings after the market close on Thursday.

Source: Reuters

MEXICO CITY, Oct 28 : Alberto Ascari was a boyhood hero for US motor racing great Mario Andretti, now 86, but few of Kimi Antonelli's compatriots were around when Italy's last Formula One world champion was making headlines.
Antonelli, 20, is set this weekend to become the only living Italian who knows what it feels like to take the chequered flag and win the Formula One championship. He would be the first to do it in 73 years, since Ascari's second title with Ferrari in 1953.
"I know the corner in Monza is named after him," the Mercedes driver told Reuters when asked what he knew about his illustrious predecessor, who was also champion in 1952 after Giuseppe "Nino" Farina won the first title with Alfa Romeo in 1950. Farina died in 1966.
"I know that he was the last Italian champion. And it was a long time ago. A very, very long time ago."

LUCKY BLUE HELMET 
Ascari was the son of a racing driver, as is Antonelli, with father Antonio a multiple race winner before his death in the 1925 French Grand Prix at Montlhery, south of Paris, long before the Formula One world championship started in 1950.
Antonio Ascari was 36 when he died, the same age almost to the day as Alberto when he crashed fatally at Monza while testing a Ferrari sportscar in 1955.
The younger Ascari had not been due to drive the car, present only to watch his friend Eugenio Castellotti in action, but decided to try it out.
Borrowing a helmet, instead of the lucky light blue one the superstitious driver always wore, and dressed in regular street clothes, the Milanese was thrown out of the car after it skidded and somersaulted off the track at the Curva del Vialone.
The chicane is now known to F1 fans as the Variante Ascari.
Four days earlier, wearing the blue helmet, he had plunged his Lancia into the Monaco harbour at the chicane coming out of the tunnel - miraculously missing an iron mooring hidden by a hay bale - and emerged relatively unscathed.
"You have to get straight back into the saddle after an accident, otherwise doubt sets in," he was quoted as telling a friend before the fateful drive.
Italians turned out in their tens of thousands for the funeral, with his blue helmet resting on the coffin, and he was buried beside his father.
"He was the fastest driver I ever saw," Britain's first world champion Mike Hawthorn recalled later. "Faster even than (Juan Manuel) Fangio".
Andretti, the 1978 world champion and now on the board of newcomers Cadillac F1, has described Ascari as his "absolute idol".
"Very cool and relaxed. He sat back doing his thing, totally in control of his car. I loved that style," the Italian-born American recalls on his website. 
"When I was 14, I saw my first Formula One race in Monza, Italy — the Italian Grand Prix. Alberto Ascari didn’t win that day, but he was fighting with Mercedes, the stronger team at the time," Andretti also wrote in the New York Times last April. "He was my hero regardless. That’s when the dream really was cemented."
Until Antonelli came along, Ascari held the record for most wins by an Italian in a single season and for successive victories.
Ascari still holds the record for most career wins by an Italian (13 from 32 races) but, with Antonelli on nine from a single campaign, it is probably only a matter of time before that too falls.

Source: Reuters

Antonelli ready for final push to become F1's youngest champion

MEXICO CITY, Oct 28 : Kimi Antonelli did not get to swig real champagne on the podium after he won in Texas last weekend, the 20-year-old Mercedes driver still too young for local drinking laws, but Sunday's Mexico City Grand Prix could be quite some shindig.
Antonelli, as even those living in the remotest valleys and islands of Italy must surely be aware by now, can become Formula One's youngest champion at the sprawling high-altitude capital's Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez as well as the first Italian to take the crown since 1953. 
Now 123 points clear at the top and winner of half the 18 races this season, Antonelli needs only finish in the top nine and it's job done. If teammate George Russell or Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton fail to win, it will be the same outcome.
Mercedes team boss and co-owner Toto Wolff agreed it was 99.9 per cent sure but Antonelli, who sprayed non-alcoholic fizz from an unbranded bottle in Austin, still needed to finish the job.

"It's either going to be a big tequila party or, if it's not a tequila party, then it's going to be caipirinha the weekend afterwards," Wolff said, with Brazil following on from Mexico.  
FINISH WITH A FLOURISH
Antonelli, whose boyish enthusiasm and enjoyment of racing have been very apparent since he took the championship lead in the third round of the season in Japan, naturally plans to wrap up the title with a flourish.
"I'm going to approach it with the same mindset, just trying to have as much fun as possible, trying to hopefully fight for another win," he said.
"It would be best to finish on a high, and that's the goal."
Mexico celebrates Day of the Dead on the same weekend, with a giant party in town even without Formula One's arrival.  
Mercedes could also clinch the constructors' title but it still looks a long shot, with the team needing a perfect afternoon and Ferrari a terrible one. Brazil the weekend after looks much more likely.
McLaren's Lando Norris won in Mexico from pole last year but the reigning champions have ground to catch up and may not be as competitive.
Red Bull's Max Verstappen also has a strong record in Mexico, with five wins in the last eight attempts, and the Dutch four-times world champion will be looking to regain momentum after Antonelli thwarted his hopes of three wins in a row.
In the constructors' standings, Red Bull and McLaren are tied on points, with the former ahead on placings, and that battle for third place overall could go down to the wire.
So too could Audi's tussle with Haas for seventh, with seven points between them.
Even further back, tail-enders and newcomers Cadillac have cause to celebrate with veteran Mexican Sergio Perez set to start his 300th race in front of his home fans after having to sit out last year following his departure from Red Bull in 2024.
"How much has to happen that you make your 300th race at home," said Perez, for whom the stars aligned only after the Saudi race was cancelled and Bahrain rescheduled in Malaysia.
"It's incredible. And to have all the people that have been with me since day one supporting me, all my sponsors, all my family, all my fans."

Source: Reuters

BRUSSELS, Oct 28 : Belgium's Federal Public Service Finance said on Wednesday that a cyberattack had hit its digital services, forcing the temporary shutdown of the country's online tax portal and several other services.
The agency said there were no indications of a data breach or that any data had been stolen, but added that the matter was being closely investigated.
• Tax-filing deadlines will be extended as a result of the disruption, the agency said, adding that a specific new date would follow as soon as possible.
• The precautionary shutdown of services is intended to limit risks and allow technical work to secure the agency's systems, it said.
• A large portion of the agency's other applications remain available with full or partial functionality, it said.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 米9月モノの貿易赤字、25年3月以来の大きさ　輸入が過去最高
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ２８日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２８日発表した９月の財（モノ）の貿易赤字（季節調整済み）は前月比２．１％（２８億ドル）増の１３４９億ドルと、２０２５年３月以来の大きさとなった。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連インフラの拡充に伴う資本財の旺盛な需要を背景に、輸入が過去最高に急増した。第３・四半期も貿易が経済成長の押し下げ要因となったことを示唆している。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想の赤字額は１３０２億ドルだった。

９月のモノの輸入は２．４％（８１億ドル）増の３４４１億ドル。資本財が７．５％急増したことが押し上げ要因となった。資本財の輸入は前年同月比で７７．２％と急増した。消費財の輸入は３．１％増加した。その他のモノの輸入は６．７％増えた。一方、金や石油を含む工業用資材の輸入は６．０％減少した。食品と自動車の輸入も減少した。

モノの輸出は２．６％（５３億ドル）増の２０９２億ドル。食品の輸出が１２．８％急増した。資本財は５．４％、消費財は６．５％、それぞれ増加した。一方、自動車と工業用資材の輸出は減少した。

卸売在庫は０．６％増加した。小売業者の在庫は０．３％増加、自動車・部品在庫は０．２％増えた。

自動車・部品を除く小売在庫は０．４％増加。前月は０．１％増だった。この項目は国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の算出に用いられる。

２６年第３・四半期のＧＤＰ速報値は２９日発表の予定で、ロイターがまとめた予想は年率換算で前期比３．２％増。ＡＩ関連投資や個人消費などがけん引し、第２・四半期の２．２％増から伸び率が加速するとみられている。なお、貿易は３四半期連続でＧＤＰのプラスに寄与していない。

ネーションワイドのエコノミスト、ダニエル・フィールハーバー氏は「貿易は四半期のＧＤＰを押し下げるが、これは企業の設備投資の継続と個人消費の勢いを示すものであり、米国経済にとって弱さではなく強さの表れだ」と述べた。

items.summary: [モスクワ ２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[モスクワ ２８日 ロイター] - ロシア外務省のザハロワ情報局長は２８日、ラブロフ外相が３０─３１日に米国で開かれる２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合に出席すると明らかにした。

ザハロワ氏は、Ｇ２０外相会合では世界経済に影響を及ぼす地政学的問題について幅広く協議されるとし、現在進行中の紛争についても取り上げられるとの見方を示した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [マイアミ ２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[マイアミ ２８日 ロイター] -  ブラジル大統領選で現職のルラ大統領に敗れたフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員が２８日、米フロリダ州マイアミに到着したことがロイターの映像で確認された。

ボルソナロ氏は敗北後、連邦最高裁判所のパスポート提出命令に従わずに米国に向けて出国したことが関係筋の話で分かっていた。米国務省は同氏と家族に入国ビザを発給する方針という。

items.title: カナダ中銀、約3年ぶり利上げ　エネルギー高巡り追加引き締め示唆
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Promit Mukherjee　David Ljunggren

［オタワ　２８日　ロイター］　 -
items.body:
Promit Mukherjee　David Ljunggren

［オタワ　２８日　ロイター］　 - カナダ銀行（中央銀行）は２８日、政策金利を２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げて２．５％とした。２０２３年７月以来、約３年ぶりとなる利上げに踏み切った。利上げは市場で広く予想されていた。中銀は、エネルギー価格の急騰が幅広い物価上昇につながるのを防ぐため、追加利上げが必要になる可能性があると指摘した。 

マックレム総裁は記者会見の冒頭で「インフレ見通しが大幅に高まり、経済が底堅さを示している中、高止まりするエネルギー価格が波及して一般的なインフレになるリスクを減らすため、政策金利の引き上げが必要だ」と述べた。

今回の利上げは銀行の貸出金利や住宅ローンの負担を押し上げ、経済成長を鈍化させる可能性がある。ただ、マックレム氏は、物価上昇を確実に抑えることを目指していると説明。会見で、政策金利はなおやや緩和的な水準にあるものの、今後数カ月の望ましい金利水準について予断を持たないと述べた。「政策金利をさらに引き上げる必要があるかもしれないが、不確実性が非常に大きいことを十分認識しており、こうした状況であらかじめ決まった政策の道筋はない」と語った。 

中銀は２０２７年のインフレ見通しを、７月時点で予想していた２．０％から３．１％に引き上げた。２０２６年の成長率は１．０％になるとし、７月時点の０．７％から上方修正した。９月のインフレ率は前年同月比３．２％となり、中銀の目標範囲である１─３％を上回った。上昇はほぼ全て、エネルギー価格と、それに関連する輸送費の上昇によるものだった。

マックレム氏は、インフレ率は年末時点で３．５％となり、２０２７年の大半で３％前後にとどまった後、２０２８年半ばまでに目標の２％近辺に戻るとの見通しを示した。「政策委員会は、インフレのリスクが高まり、金融緩和の余地が狭まったとの認識で一致した」という。

ただ、今回の利上げ後も、政策金利はなお中立金利を下回っている。中立金利とは、引き締め的でも緩和的でもないとされる金融政策の水準を指す。中銀はその中央値を２．７５％としている。 

マックレム氏は、過去の経験と中銀の各種調査から、コストの転嫁は向こう１年で拡大し、全体のインフレを押し上げるとみられるとし、「エネルギー価格の上昇とコスト転嫁が組み合わさることで、インフレの持続性が高まる」と警戒感を示した。ただ、米国との貿易摩擦や中東紛争のより早期の解決といった不確定要素が残っているとも付け加えた。

マックレム氏は、米国の新たな関税が第４・四半期の景気減速につながるとしつつ、消費支出の継続、輸出の持ち直し、企業投資の拡大により、成長は２０２７年に再び加速するはずだと自信を示した。

中銀の最新の金融政策報告書によると、カナダ経済は第２・四半期に年率３．３％という堅調な成長を記録した後、第３・四半期に２％へ減速し、第４・四半期にはさらに０．８％まで鈍化する見通し。

ただ、国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）見通しについては、２７年・２８年いずれも、７月時点で予想した１．８％から２％へ上方修正した。

マックレム氏は、この成長の上積みが、経済における需給の緩みを吸収する一助になると述べた。

ＣＩＢＣキャピタル・マーケッツのアンドルー・グランサム上級エコノミストは「世界的なエネルギー価格を巡る動向が幾分落ち着けば、基調的なインフレ指標が中銀が懸念するほど加速するとは考えていない」とし、「このため、政策金利を２．７５％を超える水準まで引き上げる必要はないとみている」と述べた。

カナダ中銀の次回の政策決定会合は１２月９日。

Oct 28 : The heavyweights of the AI industry are facing a reckoning on Wall Street, reflecting concerns over who will bear the cost of the artificial intelligence buildout that has fueled much of this year's stock market gains.
Anthropic revealed paperwork for its initial public offering on Monday, paving the way for a share sale reportedly worth $100 billion as early as next month.
Meta also unveiled a plan this week that could bring it as much as $97.5 billion through equity offerings over the coming months.
The markets will also await signs of fundraising plans when Microsoft and Alphabet report earnings later on Wednesday.

By pressing ahead with their enormous funding plans, the biggest AI players are wagering that investors' fear of missing out on future returns will outweigh their fear of overpaying for them.
AI stocks accounted for nearly 75 per cent of the S&P 500 index's return in the first half of 2026, according to an analysis by Carson Group.
"The growth of the AI ecosystem over the last several years is quite astounding," said Ehren Stanhope, chief investment strategist at Franklin Templeton's Canvas. "The idea that such large firms can compound earnings at triple digits for multiple years seems to defy the laws of economics."
But Wall Street's reaction in recent weeks suggests ambition is no longer enough to get investors to open their wallets.
Meta's shares have fallen more than 11 per cent since it unveiled plans last week to create a new class of stock to fund share sales and reported its first quarterly cash burn in more than a decade.
While Anthropic's soaring revenue helped ease AI growth concerns, its mounting losses have raised fresh questions. The company's net loss widened to $80.7 billion in the first half of 2026 from $13 billion a year earlier.
"Not even Anthropic will get a blank check," said Matt Kennedy, senior strategist at Renaissance Capital.
The funding demands are coming amid growing circular financing arrangements, in which money invested in AI companies can flow back to their investors through spending on computing infrastructure and services.
SMALLER FIRMS FEEL THE HEAT
Companies that are relatively small but carry heavy debt are in a more bleak position. CoreWeave has seen its bond yields soar, raising questions about how much it would have to pay in interest when it raises debt next.
"The danger (for CoreWeave) is the next loan. And how soon CoreWeave needs it matters as much as the price," said Matthew Tuttle, founder and CEO of Tuttle Capital Management.
Last week, CoreWeave's shares hit their lowest since May 2025 as concerns about its reliance on debt grew.
The stock has rebounded around 10 per cent so far this week, but "a company surviving and its old shareholders winning are two different outcomes," Tuttle added.
SpaceX CEO Elon Musk recently said neocloud companies could face significant consolidation and failures. He ruled out any acquisition of a neocloud company by SpaceX, saying such a deal would be "pointless."
Still, this year's AI capex by Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Oracle and Microsoft would likely equal their cumulative spend since the November 2022 launch of ChatGPT, according to data from J.P. Morgan.
"In effect, the Street appears to be underwriting the AI data center monetization case," wrote Dubravko Lakos-Bujas, the brokerage's head of global markets strategy.

Source: Reuters

By Leo Marchandon
Oct 28 : SAP, whose software is used by many of the world's largest companies, is replacing some expensive artificial-intelligence models powering its products with cheaper alternatives, a move it expects will help generate more than €2 billion in AI-driven efficiency gains 
CFO Dominik Asam told Reuters the company had removed some of the most expensive AI models from products including its internal consulting assistant and replaced them with lower-cost alternatives where performance remained strong.

SAP uses more than 70 AI models from providers including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google. Asam said the company increasingly chooses the cheapest model capable of performing a task to the required standard, while still expecting overall spending on AI to rise as adoption grows.
"The goal is healthy margins as scale grows, not an absolute reduction in AI expenditure," SAP said in answers to Reuters questions.
Unlike many AI providers, SAP charges customers for completed tasks rather than for the underlying computing resources used to generate responses, meaning lower operating costs can help improve profitability.
Customers are also paying closer attention to where AI models come from. Asam said government agencies and companies in regulated industries increasingly ask specific requirements and exclude models based on origin, while European customers increasingly demand local solutions.

items.title: エヌビディアのハギングフェイス買収、米司法省が競争影響調査＝関係筋
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Max A. Cherney　Jeffrey Dastin　Jody Godoy

[サンフランシスコ ２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Max A. Cherney　Jeffrey Dastin　Jody Godoy

[サンフランシスコ ２８日 ロイター] - 米司法省は、米半導体設計大手エヌビディアが人工知能（ＡＩ）新興企業ハギングフェイスを１２９億３０００万ドルで買収する計画について、ＡＩ分野の競争に及ぼす影響を聞き取りを行った。事情に詳しい関係者２人が明らかにした。反トラスト法（独占禁止法）当局は、エヌビディアの事業慣行を巡り数年来続けている調査を進めている。

ハギングフェイスは、開発者などの利用者が自由にダウンロードやカスタマイズできるオープン型のＡＩモデルを共有するプラットフォームを運営している。

関係者２人によると、司法省による最近の聞き取りは、エヌビディアの買収や投資、販売慣行のほか、顧客に圧力をかけたかどうかを対象としている。司法省当局者は、ハギングフェイスの買収により、エヌビディアがＡＩの流通を支える重要な拠点を掌握できるようになるかを尋ねたという。

エヌビディアは、買収が２０２７年上半期に完了する見通しで、ハギングフェイスは引き続き幅広い半導体、クラウド、ＡＩの各事業者との連携を支援するとしている。

ハギングフェイス買収を巡る司法省の聞き取りと、エヌビディアに対する調査継続の詳細が明らかになるのは今回が初めて。エヌビディアは、アンソロピックやオープンＡＩなど主要企業に出資する一方、ＡＩの膨大な計算需要を自社の半導体で支えるため、世界各地でデータセンター開発を促し、テクノロジー経済とＡＩブームの中核を担う存在となっている。

司法省が何らかの措置を取れば、半導体業界に影響が広がり、ＡＩ分野での影響力を拡大してきたエヌビディアの投資・買収戦略が揺さぶられる可能性がある。政府による調査は不正行為の証拠ではなく、必ずしも提訴につながるわけではない。

エヌビディアはコメントを控えた。司法省とハギングフェイスの担当者は、コメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

一連の調査は民主党のバイデン前大統領の政権下で始まり、共和党のトランプ米大統領の政権下でも続いている。この間、エヌビディアは時価総額で世界最大の企業となり、ＡＩ分野で突出した存在となった。トランプ氏が調査に関与していることを示す情報はなく、調査が司法省による何らかの措置につながらない可能性もある。

関係者の１人によると、司法省は調査の一環として、エヌビディアによるスケジＭＤの買収も調べている。２０２５年１２月の買収を受け、ＡＩの専門家の間では、国家安全保障に関わるスーパーコンピューターの運用を支えるスケジＭＤのオープンソースソフトウエアを引き続き利用できるか、懸念が浮上した。エヌビディアは、誰でも利用できる状態とサポートを維持すると約束している。

関係者によると、ハギングフェイスの買収計画を巡る聞き取りでは、エヌビディアが同社のＡＩプラットフォームをどのように利用してＡＩ市場の競合に不利益を与え得るかや、買収した事業を交渉力の強化に利用できるかなどを確認している。

当局者はハギングフェイスの競合企業についても質問しているという。

Drones hit container ship off Bulgaria, crew safe and ashore

Reuters, Oct 28 (Reuters) – Sea drones struck a container ship off Bulgaria’s Black Sea coast on Wednesday, the ship’s owner and the government said, the latest in a string of attacks that have raised concerns about the growing scope of Russia’s war in Ukraine.  

It was not clear who carried out the attack on the Greek ship that was sailing under the Liberian flag in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone (EEZ), or what the vessel’s 421 containers were carrying.

“A container ship was hit…with three naval drones, approximately 21 miles southeast of Shabla,” Defence Minister Dimitar Stoyanov told reporters on the sidelines of a regional security meeting.

Show Full Article

Bulgaria’s transport ministry said in a statement that four naval and police boats had been dispatched to assist the vessel, which was travelling from the Israeli port of Haifa to Constanța in Romania, and that the 18 crew members had been evacuated. 

The ship’s owner, Contships Management, confirmed the attack and a company official said all the crew of 14 Filippinos and 4 Ukrainians, were safe and ashore.

A maritime security source with knowledge of the matter said the ship had been badly damaged and was listing.

INTERNATIONAL CONCERN

Drone attacks on merchant ships off Bulgaria have likely killed some two dozen international seafarers in recent weeks, according to government statements on missing crew members. At least six merchant vessels have been attacked.

The strikes have been in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone, an area that stretches beyond Bulgaria’s waters but where the country holds sole rights to explore and manage resources. 

The attacks have prompted international condemnation and concern about the growing reach of the war in Ukraine. Bulgaria, a member of the European Union and NATO, has sought allied assistance to bolster maritime security. 

Ukraine has blamed the attacks on Russia and Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev has said the attacks appear to benefit Russia, but Moscow has denied involvement. 

In a sign of the international concern, Turkish Defence Minister Yasar Guler warned Russia and Ukraine on Wednesday against carrying out attacks on commercial vessels in the Black Sea. He said Ankara reserved the right to take legal action against the strikes. 

(Reporting by Aleksandar Vasovic, Stoyan Nenov and Renee Maltezou’; Editing by Kirsten Donovan, Edward McAllister and Timothy Heritage)

items.title: イエメンのフーシ派がアデン空港攻撃、事前に退避警告＝政府当局者
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [アデン／ドバイ ２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[アデン／ドバイ ２８日 ロイター] - イエメン政府当局者は、親イラン武装組織フーシ派が２８日、アデン空港を攻撃したと明らかにした。フーシ派はこれに先立ち、空港から退避するよう警告していた。中東の紛争に巻き込まれたイエメンでは戦闘が激化している。 

運輸省当局者２人がロイターに語ったところによると、攻撃後に航空交通は停止された。ある関係筋によると、国連職員の一部が攻撃の直前に空港から退避しており、負傷者はいなかったという。

フーシ派のヤヒヤ・サリーア報道官はＸへの投稿で、サウジ軍の武器輸送機が存在していたことから退避警告を出したと説明した。

サウジ当局から直ちにコメントは得られなかった。

国連の国際移住機関（ＩＯＭ）は、アデンでの攻撃の報告後、同機関の職員の無事が確認されたと発表した。

イエメン首都サヌアと同国北西部の大半を支配するフーシ派は、これまで繰り返しアデン空港を標的にしてきた。住民によると、警告が出される前にも市内の他の場所で爆発音が聞こえたという。

items.title: US stocks today: US stocks turn choppy as megacaps offset chip gains before Fed meet
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: In the US stock market, a mixed performance emerged as chipmakers like Micron Technology surged, buoyed by favorable reports from SK Hynix, while major tech players such as Tesla and Apple faced declines. Investors eye the Federal Reserve's imminent interest rate decision and important earnings announcements from Microsoft and Alphabet. The Nasdaq showed positive momentum this week, rising around 2%, reflecting growing optimism surrounding artificial intelligence.
items.body: US stocks traded in a narrow range on Wednesday as gains in chipmakers following strong results from South Korea's SK Hynix were offset by declines in heavyweight technology stocks, with investors awaiting the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision and key earnings from Microsoft and Alphabet, Reuters reported.At 10:01 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 73.40 points, or 0.14%, at 52,450.97. The S&P 500 gained 0.09% to 7,729.20, while the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.03% to 26,470.68, according to Reuters. For live updates on US Markets, click here Chip stocks rally on SK Hynix resultsMemory chipmaker Micron Technology rose 4.8% to its highest level in more than two weeks after SK Hynix reported a more than sevenfold jump in quarterly profit. SK Hynix's US listed shares surged 10.6%, while the Philadelphia semiconductor index gained 0.9%, putting it on track for a fourth straight session of gains, Reuters said.The strength in chips was partly offset by losses in megacaps. Tesla fell 1.9% after gaining more than 9% over the previous two sessions, while Apple slipped 0.6%. SpaceX dropped 3.2%.Alphabet rose 1.2% after a media report said OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips.Fed, AI spending and hyperscaler earnings in focusThe Nasdaq has gained about 2% this week as sentiment around artificial intelligence improved following Anthropic's US IPO filing on Monday. items.title: コモディティー価格、中東戦争などで今年23％上昇へ＝世銀予測
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Andrea Shalal

[ワシントン ２８日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Andrea Shalal

[ワシントン ２８日 ロイター] - 世界銀行は２８日、世界的に２０２６年のコモディティー（商品）価格が２３％上昇する見込みだと発表した。その理由として、エネルギー価格の上昇、中東戦争中の貨物輸送の混乱、黒海における穀物輸送の問題、金などの安全資産に対する高い需要を挙げている。

最新の「一次産品市場の見通し」で、世界的なショックが重なり、石油、天然ガス、食料、金属の価格が今年に入って急騰したと指摘。また、中東紛争が激化し、ロシアの石油インフラへの被害が続けば、状況はさらに悪化する可能性があると述べた。

来年の商品価格は７％下落すると予想されるものの、１９５０年以来最悪のエルニーニョ現象予測など、継続的なショックによって食料コモディティー価格は高止まりし、インフレ率の上昇や金融引き締め政策を巡る懸念が高まる可能性があるとしている。

世界経済は現時点で、将来の供給ショックに対してより脆弱になっている。世銀は、中東戦争で世界の石油在庫は枯渇しており、世界の石油供給量は２０２６年には５．２％減少すると予想されていると指摘。これは２０年の世界的な景気後退を除けば、過去４０年間で最大の減少幅という。

世銀の副チーフエコノミスト、アイハン・コーゼ氏は「商品市場は複数の大きなショックに同時に見舞われている」と指摘。「エネルギーコストの上昇と貿易の混乱により、幅広い商品価格が上昇しており、インフレ、食料不安、経済成長の悪化を招く恐れがある」と述べた。

World Bank sees commodity prices up 23% in 2026 due to Middle East war, other shocks

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 28 : Global commodity prices are set to surge 23 per cent in 2026, the World Bank said on Wednesday, citing rising energy prices and disruptions to cargo shipping during the Middle East war, grain shipment problems in the Black Sea and high demand for safe-haven assets such as gold.
Oil, natural gas, food and metals prices all rose sharply this year as global shocks mounted, the World Bank said in its latest Commodity Markets Outlook. It said the situation could worsen if the conflict in the Middle East ratcheted up and damage to Russian oil infrastructure continued.
Commodity prices were expected to ease by 7 per cent next year, it said, but continued shocks - including forecasts for the worst El Niño weather effect since 1950 - could keep food commodity prices elevated, raising the specter of higher inflation and tighter monetary policy.
The global economy was more vulnerable to future supply shocks at the moment. Global oil stocks have been depleted during the war in the Middle East, and global oil supply is expected to drop 5.2 per cent in 2026, the biggest drop in four decades outside the 2020 global recession, the bank said.

"Commodity markets are being hit by several major shocks at once," said Ayhan Kose, the World Bank’s deputy chief economist. "Higher energy costs and trade disruptions are driving up prices across a broad range of commodities, threatening to worsen inflation, food insecurity, and economic growth."
The bank released its twice-yearly report on Wednesday, two days before foreign ministers from the world's 20 largest economies are due to gather in Atlanta, Georgia for a meeting that will focus on the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine.
Kose said the World Bank was focused on protecting the world's poorest people and supporting low-income countries already grappling with heavy debt burdens.
The bank had already provided $8.7 billion in low-cost loans and other aid to 25 countries affected negatively by the war in the Middle East, the report said. This included 10 countries that retooled existing programs to cover crisis-related expenses, and 19 that had tapped new resources, with some using both.
The report, released twice a year, said global energy prices surged 32 per cent in 2026, reaching their highest level since 2022's invasion of Ukraine by Russia.
With oil output down, Brent oil prices were expected to remain elevated in the near term, averaging $92 per barrel for the year. Prices would be even higher if oil demand were not forecast to drop 2.5 per cent this year, the third-largest drop behind the 2020 COVID shock and the 1980 oil crisis.
It said food commodity prices were set to rise just over 10 per cent in 2026 due to grain shipment disruptions caused by hostilities between Russia and Ukraine in the Black Sea, and another 7 per cent-plus in 2027, for a cumulative increase of nearly 18 per cent.
An adverse scenario that coupled a record El Nino, more Black Sea grain shipment disruptions, escalation in the Middle East conflict and ongoing damage to Russian oil infrastructure could drive food prices 12 per cent higher than expected, it said. That could trigger a food crisis like the one seen in the early 2010s, when more than 40 million additional people were pushed into extreme poverty, the bank noted.
Fertilizer prices were expected to rise 14 per cent in 2026, due to a surge in urea prices, returning to 2025 levels in 2027.
Metals prices were projected to rise 25 per cent and hit a new high in 2026, with aluminum, copper and tin all setting new records as a result of supply disruptions and strong demand from investments in renewable energy, electric vehicles and data centers, the bank said.
Precious metals prices were projected to surge by 40 per cent in 2026, amid elevated demand for safe-haven assets triggered by geopolitical and policy uncertainty, with some moderation seen in 2027.

Source: Reuters

LONDON, Oct 28 : Finance minister John Healey on Wednesday unveiled plans in his budget to support the development of data centres in Britain, linking the measure to the government's artificial intelligence and national security objectives.
Healey said the government would launch a new British Data Centre Covenant requiring operators to invest in local communities, create jobs and protect water supplies, in return for priority grid connections and, where necessary, permission to build on-site power generation.
"Built on sovereignty and security, I want to ensure that the British people can benefit from the huge potential upsides of AI," Healey told parliament.
He said the aim was to keep sensitive data used by public services and the armed forces in Britain as the use of artificial intelligence expands.
Healey also announced an AI Challenge Prize to encourage the use of AI in public services and funding to support workers adapting to technological change.

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 28 : Mars is a dusty place. Dust is circulated by everyday winds, whirlwinds called dust devils and larger dust storms raging at local, regional and global scales. Dust is a factor that must be addressed in any human mission to Mars, and new data from a NASA rover is revealing just how much of a challenge it may present.
NASA's Perseverance rover, operating in and around an area called Jezero Crater in the Martian northern hemisphere since landing in 2021, has detected the finest particles of dust to date on Earth's planetary neighbor. It documented ultrafine particles as small as around 100 nanometers wide, about 500 times thinner than a human hair.
"A smaller particle size does not necessarily make dust more dangerous, but smaller particles do have a higher potential to penetrate deeper into the human body and are harder for the body to clear," said planetary scientist Scott VanBommel of Washington University in St. Louis, a member of the Perseverance science team and lead author of a study describing the findings in the journal Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.
"Like any substance, toxicity depends on dose and duration. Martian dust contains silica, iron compounds and chlorine compounds such as perchlorate, which are known to be harmful at high enough doses on Earth," VanBommel said.
